package.description: Windows tray utility / filesystem watcher / launcher for syncthing

en-US.description: Windows tray utility / filesystem watcher / launcher for syncthing
en-US.longDescription: SyncTrayzor is a little tray utility for Syncthing on Windows. It hosts and wraps Syncthing, making it behave more like a native Windows application and less like a command-line utility with a web browser interface.
en-US.name: SyncTrayzor
